description: Construction of two step free access lift towers connecting the existing passenger footbridge with the platforms and associated works (Listed Building Consent application with Prior Approval under Schedule 2 Part 18 Class A of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development)(England) Order 2015 (as amended).
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design & Access Statement dated 3 November 2018; Heritage Statement 3195-TWBN-BAS-D219-0-A-0900 Rev 04 dated 08/02/2019; Ownership planMap Title, drawings 3195-TWBN-BAS-D219-0-DR-A0100 Rev P03; 3195-TWBN-BAS-D219-0-DR-A0101 Rev P03; 3195-TWBN-BAS-D219-0-DR-A0102 Rev P03; 3195-TWBN-BAS-D219-0-DR-A0103 Rev P03; 3195-TWBN-BAS-D219-0-DR-A0200 Rev P04; 3195-TWBN-BAS-D219-0-DR-A0201 Rev P04; 3195-TWBN-BAS-D219-0-DR-A0203 Rev P04; 3195-TWBN-BAS-D219-0-DR-A0301 Rev P03; 3195-TWBN-BAS-D219-0-DR-A0302 Rev P03; 3195-TWBN-BAS-D219-0-DR-A0303 Rev P04; 3195-TWBN-BAS-D219-0-DR-A0304 Rev P03; 3195-TWBN-BAS-D219-0-DR-A0306 Rev P03; 3195-TWBN-BAS-D219-0-DR-A0315 Rev P03; 3195-TWBN-BAS-D219-0-DR-A0318 Rev P03; 3195-TWBN-BAS-D219-0-DR-A0324 Rev P01; 3195-TWBN-BAS-D219-0-DR-A0325 Rev P01; 3195-TWBN-BAS-D219-0-DR-A0701 Rev P02; 3195-TWBN-BAS-D219-0-DR-A0800 Rev P03; received: 21/02/2019. Cover Letter ref: LUL/OSY/SFA/1 dated 20 February 2019; Excerpt comprising Clause XVI of Section 16 of Railway Clauses Consolidation Act, 1845; Excerpt comprising Chapter cxc of Hounslow and Metropolitan Railway Act, 1880; and Hounslow and Metropolitan Railway Sheet 1 Frame No. 2; received: 13/03/2019. Planning Statement dated April 2019 received: 16/04/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The windows within the north facing elevation of the lift lobby shall be obscure glazed and fixed shut.

Condition : 4 - During the works a full record shall be made (and annotated, including photographs), and kept with the approved drawings and background research material in a log book and a copy of which shall be lodged with the local planning authority within one month after the works hereby approved are completed.
